entities.name: Cilissa
entities.description: A Setessan warrior on Theros, an orphan with a bond to the goddess Karametra.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: Goddess whose vision welcomed Cilissa and whose seed pods warm and protect her.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: The city to which Cilissa was brought as an orphan and which she later defended.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starfield above whose portal Karametra appeared.

entities.name: Thora
entities.description: Older girl who trained and patrolled with Cilissa and was petrified by a Nyxborn gorgon.

entities.name: Niketa
entities.description: Trainer who encouraged Cilissa to attack more aggressively.

entities.name: Kelios
entities.description: A boy who left on his peregrination and looked at Cilissa while hugging Thora.

entities.name: Natasa
entities.description: Setessan warrior petrified by the Nyxborn gorgon.

entities.name: Delia
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old killed by a Nyxborn minotaur.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Creatures with bodies of night sky who attacked Setessa in droves.

entities.name: Akroan attackers
entities.description: Attackers who killed Cilissa's father and drove her from her village.

events.summary: At six, Cilissa is brought to Setessa as an orphan and receives a vision of Karametra.
events.quote: A vision of Karametra hovered in the starfield of Nyx above Cilissa

events.summary: Karametra's sparks create glowing pods whose warmth brings Cilissa memories of her parents' fall to Akroan attackers.
events.quote: Her father fell to the first wave of Akroan attackers.

events.summary: At nine, Cilissa spars with Thora and then Niketa, who tells her to be more aggressive.
events.quote: It was not enough to simply be the strongest or the fastest.

events.summary: At fourteen, Cilissa and Thora say farewell to Kelios on his peregrination, and Thora is furious with Cilissa.
events.quote: Thora was furious with Cilissa when Kelios left

events.summary: At eighteen, the Nyxborn attack Setessa in droves and Cilissa helps defend the city.
events.quote: the Nyxborn were all attacking Setessa in droves

events.summary: A Nyxborn minotaur kills Delia, and a Nyxborn gorgon petrifies Thora and Natasa.
events.quote: she saw Thora and Natasa become pale statues of stone

events.summary: Cilissa kills the gorgon with her axe and lures a minotaur into cleaving open Karametra's pod, dissolving all Nyxborn.
events.quote: All the Nyxborn slowly dissolved into nothingness.

events.summary: Months later, Cilissa welcomes a new group of orphaned children with Karametra's voice.
events.quote: She let her voice be infused by the presence of Karametra

relations.note: Has a bond with the goddess.
relations.quote: who has a bond with the goddess Karametra
Cilissa is a Setessan warrior on the plane of Theros

relations.note: Trainer who spars with and coaches her.
relations.quote: The trainer, Niketa , helped her up

relations.note: Fights them in defense of Setessa.
relations.quote: Cilissa blocked as the Nyxborn charged.
